data.one_liner: A ListView widget that automatically animates items when the list changes.
data.what_it_does: AutoAnimatedList watches a list of items and animates insertions, removals and moves using built‑in transitions. It requires only the items and an itemBuilder, handling diff calculations internally.
use_when: You need animated list updates without writing boilerplate diff logic
You want a simple declarative API for common list animations
avoid_when: You need highly custom animations per item
You require fine‑grained performance tuning for very large lists
weaknesses: Limited customization of animation curves per operation
Relies on diffutil_dart which may add overhead for huge lists
